responsibility: This file implements GCC’s late RTL instruction reorganization pass for delay-slot architectures, along with the follow-on machine-dependent reorg pass wrapper. It analyzes jump and return structure, fills delay slots using local, eager, and relaxation strategies, updates resource and label information, collects statistics about slot filling and annulled branches, and marks the function as delay-slot scheduled; it also exposes a pass that invokes targetm.machine_dependent_reorg after generic delay-slot handling. Its responsibility is final backend reorganization of control-flow-related instruction scheduling for targets with delay-slot semantics.
